Irish Visa Decision Tracker

Live • Personal Project

Tracks visa decisions published daily by the Embassy of Ireland, New Delhi, turning a flat daily spreadsheet (no history, no search, no trends) into a searchable, browsable dashboard. A GitHub Actions scraper runs 4× daily to fetch the embassy’s ‘.ods’ file, handle weekends and public holidays gracefully, and upsert records into a Google Sheet (the database). The Apps Script Web App exposes a clean HTTP API read by a four-tab dashboard: live snapshot, daily summary, full history with date-picker, and a suggestions form.
